<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/v1/workspaces"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Create a workspace under an organization. The id is minted by the server. Requires action__workspace__create on the organization. The name must be unique among the organization's workspaces (case-insensitive, trimmed): a clash is 409 `name_conflict`. An organization that is not migrated to the workspace model (or does not exist) is 409 `workspaces_not_available`.
